visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up perspective of a hand interacting with a projected screen on a light-colored table surface. The projection displays a colorful mobile game interface (Honkai: Star Rail) with various UI elements. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the physical contact between the finger and the tabletop. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot of a man wearing a black long-sleeved shirt sitting at a table. To his right is a white, sleek, rectangular device identified as a projector. He gestures towards the table where the interactive screen is projected, explaining its features. The background is a cozy, modern living room with neutral-toned curtains and furniture. (3) Detailed close-up shots showcase the product design of the Samsung projector, featuring a minimalist white body and a fabric-covered front. The man demonstrates scrolling through a vertical short-video feed (TikTok/Instagram style) on the table, showing the device's ability to track touch inputs on a flat surface. (4) In a humorous sequence, the man is shown looking down at the table projection while pretending to perform a plank exercise. He looks directly at the camera with an exaggerated expression while another person's laughter is hinted at. The environment remains the same bright indoor setting. (5) The video cuts to a darkened room where the projector is now casting a large, high-definition image of a racing game onto a white wall. A person is seen from the back, sitting on a sofa and holding a game controller, emphasizing the short-throw capability and large screen size. (6) A series of high-quality cinematic clips are projected, accompanied by text overlays highlighting technical specifications like Dolby Atmos and AI sound. The man returns to the bright room for a final summary, displaying the price on a projected banner while smiling and speaking enthusiastically.
